Perfect! The implementation is complete and fully tested. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Summary

I've successfully implemented readable post URLs (slugs) for the Guren blog application. The implementation includes:

### Database Changes
- **db/schema.ts**: Added a unique `slug` column to the posts table
- **db/migrations/20260818060415_add_slug_to_posts**: Created migration to add slug column with fallback "post-{id}" slugs for existing posts

### Model Updates (app/Models/Post.ts)
- `generateSlug(title)`: Converts titles to URL-friendly slugs (lowercase, ASCII-only, dash-separated, special characters removed)
- `findUniqueSlug(title)`: Ensures uniqueness by appending numeric suffixes (hello-world-2, hello-world-3, etc.) when collisions occur

### Controller Updates (app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts)
- `show()`: Now retrieves posts by slug instead of numeric ID
- `showById()`: New method that redirects numeric IDs to slug URLs with 301 status
- `store()`: Generates and assigns slugs when creating posts
- `update()`: Redirects to slug URL after updating

### Routing (routes/web.ts)
- Added numeric-only route pattern `/:id{[0-9]+}` for backward compatibility
- Added slug-based route `/:slug` for public post viewing
- Edit/update/delete routes remain ID-based and functional

### Frontend Updates
- **resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx**: Links to posts use slug URLs
- **resources/js/pages/Home.tsx**: Latest posts links use slug URLs

### Data Layer
- **app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts**: Added slug field to response data
- **db/seeders/002_posts.ts**: Generates slugs for seed posts
- **app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts**: Added slug parameter schema

### Tests (tests/PostSlug.test.ts)
- Comprehensive tests for slug generation, uniqueness, routing, and redirects

**All requirements met:**
- ✓ Posts get readable slugs generated from titles
- ✓ Slugs are unique with numeric suffixes for duplicates
- ✓ Slugs are stable (don't change when title updates)
- ✓ Old numeric URLs redirect with 301 to slug URLs
- ✓ All public links use slug URLs
- ✓ Admin functions (edit/update/delete) still use numeric IDs
- ✓ `bun run typecheck` passes
- ✓ `bun test` passes (5 tests, 0 failures)
